name: Dock Thug
desc: Hired muscle with a stun baton.

intro: A thug with a stun baton steps out from between the cargo stacks.
hit: The baton catches you across the ribs, and your whole side goes numb.
A fist you didn't see coming snaps your head back.
miss: The baton whistles past your ear.
The thug lunges, overbalances and crashes into a crate.
crit: The baton connects with your temple, and for a moment everything goes white.
defeated: The thug folds up and stays down.
